scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('server.js', { force: true });"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'), cp = require('node:child_process'); process.exit(fs.existsSync('dev/run-tests.mjs') ? (cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ['dev/run-tests.mjs'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1) : (cp.spawnSync(process.execPath, ['node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc', '--noEmit'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1));"
